recent_posts.title: No Dirty Reads: Everything you always wanted to know about SQL isolation levels (but were too afraid to ask)
recent_posts.summary: Transaction isolation levels in SQL determine how much a transaction is affected by other concurrent transactions. There are four levels: READ UNCOMMITTED, READ COMMITTED, REPEATABLE READ, and SERIALIZABLE. The higher the isolation level, the less affected the transaction is, but there is a trade-off between data accuracy and performance.
